definitions.explanation: The act of looking at something secretly, especially by peering through an opening, gap, or from a hidden vantage point.

examples.japanese: {覗|のぞ}き{見|み}はやめ⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
⟦{隙間|すきま}→隙間：00389_sukima⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{覗|のぞ}き{見|み}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{覗|のぞ}き{見|み}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦プライバシー→プライバシー：06806_puraibashii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{侵害|しんがい}→侵害：11563_shingai⟧だ。
examples.english: Peeking at someone else's email is an invasion of privacy.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{覗|のぞ}く→覗く：02388_nozoku⟧ (to peek; to peer) + ⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧ (looking). Emphasizes the physical act of peering through or around something to see what is hidden. Carries a negative connotation of intrusiveness. Can also be used in digital contexts (peeking at someone's screen or messages).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {覗|のぞ}き{見|み}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to peek; to spy
- {覗|のぞ}き{見|み}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧: anti-peeping (e.g., screen filters)
- {覗|のぞ}き{見|み}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be peeked at

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{盗|ぬす}み{見|み}→盗み見：26023_nusumimi⟧: sneaking a look — emphasizes the secretive, stolen nature of the glance
- ⟦{覗|のぞ}く→覗く：02388_nozoku⟧: to peek; to peer — the base verb, more neutral
- ⟦{盗撮|とうさつ}→盗撮：20492_tousatsu⟧: hidden camera filming — a criminal act of secretly photographing or filming
